notes.title: V 0.1.4!
notes.content:
The Language Update!

- Portuguese, Spanish and German now enabled.
- Fixed all sorts of minor bugs.
- Got rid of the weird glitching around the narrator text.

This update revolves mostly around making sure localization works and enabling the above three languages and making sure the fonts for them all look nice. Hoo, boy! was it a lot of work.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.3.e
notes.content:
- Shortened the length of the demo to make it more focused.
- Players can now use WASD to move, and dynamically switch between direct and point to click movement.
- Player can now disable click to move completely.
- Optimized Synthstreet, the racing simulator. Should load much much faster now.
- Cross hairs now animate when you have a full charge
- Idiot-proofed the tutorial maybe? Hard to say because all NJC players are beautiful, popular and intelligent. So this one is impossible to test.
- Simplified Sprinkles Quest. Made it 10% more interesting in the process. Drew a funny vending machine.
- Removed Rat's fur from crime-scene. My girl is innocent.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.3.d
notes.content:
- Added A few clarifying lines of text when you examine the cat in Busters Office.
- Added a few unintrusive tutorial moments like how to walk, how to drive
- A few minor updates to Spiders dungeon.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.3.c
notes.content:
- Added pop up art to charged shot tutorial illustrating it, replacing dialogue explaining what a charged shot is
- Added Discord Buttons 
- Added more bug report buttons/feedback buttons. (Pause screen and title screen)
- Removed some redundant dialogue from the target dummy encounter. 
- Added unlocked action animation to the target dummy when you can blast it.
